summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state (_thread_loop, _thread_id) set and cleared in the run entry point's try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests covering not-running (before and after run), same-thread, TextLog widget access, awaitable callable, timeout exception propagation, argument forwarding, and exit value; all 8 pass. Ran tests with PYTHONPATH=src because the venv resolves textual to the base checkout. Full suite: 68 failures both with and without the change (pre-existing async-test environment gap); passes went from 605 to 613. Nothing committed. Not verified on Python 3.7 (venv is 3.9).
